item.title: Queen City Shout returns to Springfield
item.description: The 15th Annual Queen City Shout festival will be held from Mar. 23-29, showcasing local music, film, dance, art and more, with ticket sales supporting local poverty relief organizations.

item.title: Missouri lawsuit claims charcoal plant covered nearby properties in toxic fallout
item.description: SUMMERSVILLE, Mo. — Shannon County property owners have filed a lawsuit suit against Royal Oak Enterprises, alleging pollution from a charcoal plant near Summersville has coated their land in grime, damaged property and made them sick. item.description: DIXON, Mo. — A Dixon woman has been charged with second-degree murder after a man was found fatally shot Friday in Pulaski County. item.title: Near 80° Monday before storms return to the Ozarks
item.description: Springfield, MO (KOLR) - Cloudy skies and cold temperatures stuck around for Saturday, but a very positive change is on the way as sunny skies and much warmer weather are coming to the Ozarks. On Sunday, most locations can expect temperatures to climb into the upper 60s, with a few lucky spots even reaching 70°. [...]

item.title: One person dead in crash on U.S. 65 in Christian County
item.description: A crash on US-65 in southern Christian County has left at least one person dead and caused major slowdowns, with the driver possibly distracted and not buckled up.
